snippet.title: CODA for Playdate - What a Weird, Wonderful World
snippet.description:
The Playdate is a nice little place to play little indie games, so I'm starting with CODA, a creepy adventure game made by Simon Gander that takes about half an hour of your time. Another World comes to mind, because its world is eery, you are transported with limited information and you plod your way trying to make sense of it.

The gameplay might not be great, there are simple puzzle rooms at play and while there is interesting uses of the playdate features it's not what stuck with me. It's the World which was created which will stick with me and the story, or lack there of a la Returnal. 

Only available on Itch at the moment, not on the Playdate Catalog, hopefully it goes there soon, but it does mean you can either sideload it to your playdate device or play using Playdate Simulator. 

As this is my first video on this channel, I forgot to enable links...

For Gameplay without me speaking: https://youtu.be/iKKgFMvtUrI
